info.title: viggle/video-remix
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "viggle/video-remix", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for viggle/video-remix; use POST /v2/models/viggle/video-remix/requests.

schema.description: Router body of a Video Remix.

background_mode.description: original (the default), solid or transparent. `transparent` adds an alpha matte video, `alpha_url`.

bg_color.description: Solid background colour as `R,G,B`. Only with `background_mode=solid`.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the character image.

model.description: Optional render model: V3 or V4.

motion_video_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the driving video, up to 100 MiB.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Viggle Video Remix: the ready `GET /proxy/viggle/v1/videos/{video_id}` render, forwarded unchanged. The video is at `video_url`, and a transparent render's alpha matte at `alpha_url`. The URLs are Viggle's and expire after one hour.

ViggleError.description: Viggle's error object, set when the job failed.

alpha_url.description: The alpha matte video of a transparent render, once ready.

credits_used.description: Viggle credits the job is charged, set once it is ready.

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds the charge is based on, set once the job is ready.

id.description: Render id (`render_` prefix). Poll it on the videos route.

stage.description: Coarse progress stage while the render runs.

status.description: Status: queued, processing, ready, failed or cancelled.

video_url.description: The finished video, once ready. The URL lasts one hour.
